phases.name: Full run of approved v1 (web, MyEdit demo)
phases.note: MyEdit demo, Chrome 1440 × 900 unless a row says otherwise, default account (Chrome profile default, port 9333) unless the segment says so. Build from device-web build (version.json) at every segment start. Credits: stage2 ledger before and after every charge.

segments.name: Entries, SEO page and upload, input limits
segments.note: Build check and credits (balance + stage2 ledger) first. Upload rows use device-web upload with the fx- videos; no generation. fx-10gb is a sparse file made at the row.
segments.name_zh: 入口、SEO 頁與上傳、輸入限制

segments.name: Settings panel, price, Professional length limit
segments.note: One 480p upload carries the settings and price rows; the fps and resolution rows each upload their own fx- video. TC-036 and TC-088 are the only charged rows here.
segments.name_zh: 設定面板、價格、Professional 長度限制

segments.name: Price: every combination (40 rows)
segments.note: One upload of fx-480p30; read the price line for each combination; nothing is charged.

segments.name: Generate and result, My Library, emails, other tools, Knowledge Center rules
segments.note: The four reference generations (TC-089 – TC-092) feed the result, My Library and email rows; Agent TC-116 last. Read credits and the ledger before and after each charge.
segments.name_zh: 生成與結果、My Library、電子郵件、其他工具、知識庫規則

segments.name: Mobile web (375 × 812) and Video Restoration (old room)
segments.note: Set the window to 375 × 812 for the mobile rows and restore 1440 × 900 after.
segments.name_zh: 手機版網頁（375 × 812）與 Video Restoration（舊房間）

segments.name: Product rules (default account)
segments.note: Rotated video, leave-page warnings, 1201 px crossing, 150 % zoom, Light Mode, time codes, tab titles, card thumbnails.

segments.name: Other accounts last: Free, signed out, storage full
segments.note: TC-096 runs first (empty Recent Gen on the Free account, before anything is generated there), then TC-039 on Free, TC-139 in a fresh signed-out profile, TC-147/148 on the storage-full account. Switch with device-web account NAME; never sign out and in.
segments.name_zh: 最後跑其他帳號：Free、未登入、空間已滿

phases.name_zh: 核准 v1 完整執行（網頁版，MyEdit demo）
phases.note_zh: MyEdit demo，Chrome 1440 × 900（列上另有指定除外），預設帳號（Chrome 設定檔 default，連接埠 9333，區段另有指定除外）。每個區段開始時用 device-web build 讀版本（version.json）。點數：每次扣點前後都讀 stage2 點數明細。

phases.name: Rows v2 added or changed (web, MyEdit demo)
phases.note: Rows draft 20261126-104640 added or changed (REQ-008), in journey order; same setup as R1. Price rows spend nothing; TC-117 needs one 8-credit 60 fps job; TC-138 one 8-credit job.
phases.name_zh: v2 新增或修改的測試列（web，MyEdit demo）
phases.note_zh: 草稿 20261126-104640 新增或修改的測試列（REQ-008），依使用流程排序；設定同 R1。價格列不扣點；TC-117 需要一次 8 點的 60 fps 工作，TC-138 一次 8 點。

segments.name: Entries, upload limits and price wording
segments.note: Default account. TC-151/152 read the SEO upload boxes; TC-018 removed (not tested).
segments.name_zh: 入口、上傳限制與價格文字

segments.name: Generate, other tools, narrow window and product rules
segments.note: TC-117 and TC-138 spend credits (stage2 ledger before and after). Narrow rows hold 375 × 812 with the CDP override. TC-096 on the free account, TC-147 on the storage-full account; TC-153 Blocked until a full Studio Pro account exists.
segments.name_zh: 生成、其他工具、窄視窗與產品規則
